events.command: ls -A; echo ---; git ls-files; echo ---; grep -rnI "lookup\|CACHE_TTL_SECONDS\|pricing_cache" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^./.git/"

git add pricing_cache.py && git commit -F - <<'EOF'
Raise pricing cache TTL to 1h and drop stale-snapshot fallback

CACHE_TTL_SECONDS goes from 900 to 3600, so entries are now refreshed
hourly instead of every 15 minutes, cutting pricing feed fetches by 4x.

The lookup() helper that served the previous snapshot when the feed was
late is removed along with it: it had no callers, and serving a snapshot
that can now be up to an hour old is worse than a miss. Consumers get a
cache miss and re-fetch instead of a silently stale price.
EOF
